scope: Original sound set for the storm-throne slot: base / idle / feature themes, ambience, free-spins intro, retrigger, feature outro, total-win fanfare, win tiers 1–4 + max (heads, count-up beds, tier-ups, landings), 7 multiplier callout classes, all game effects, non-verbal character vocal placeholders and a 19-line recorded voice-bank slot. Presentation only; nothing reads or changes a result.
originality: All music and effects are original note data and code synthesis (lib/slot-audio/scores/storm.ts, sfx/storm.ts, synth/anatolian.ts). No samples, no recordings, no third-party melodies or motifs; no commercial slot score imitated. Instruments are synthesized approximations (zurna-like reed, ney-like flute, bağlama-like Karplus-Strong lute with sympathetic strings, davul, darbuka, frame drum, taiko-style drum, low horns, male "oh" choir, bronze, thunder/rain/wind).

environment.machine: cloud container, 4 vCPU (load average 0.5–2 during these runs)

method: Headless Chromium, production code path: prebuilt render worker bundle (Web Worker pool, 3 workers) for synthesis + OfflineAudioContext reverb + JS mastering; BS.1770 loudness, 4× true peak, loop seam statistic; 16-bit TPDF WAV export. Escalation and runtime chain run through the real bus graph (buildBusGraph) at the default mix.
commands: bash scripts/use-node.sh node storm-measure.tmp.mjs music|sfx|load|chain|escalation|cascadeload (harness copied into apps/web temporarily, then removed)

music.about: A Hicaz (A Bb C# D E F G), 96 BPM, 18-bar seamless loop (45 s). A: the 4-bar "storm call" hook on a zurna-like reed (ornamented), its answer with a low horn counter-line · B: D minor (iv) — bağlama melody with tremolo over a male "oh" choir and horn swells, davul half time, thunder crack · C: breakdown — ney plays the hook slowed over a drone and darbuka, davul fill and cymbal swell into A. Bağlama ostinato, round bass, davul with stick, darbuka dum/tek/ka, frame drum, taiko and bronze gong accents.
A Hicaz, 96 BPM, 8-bar loop (20 s): the hook and its answer on a breathy ney over an A–E drone, sparse bağlama plucks, low horn swells at the cadences and a soft frame drum; no davul.

D Hicaz (D Eb F# G A Bb C), 116 BPM, 16-bar loop (33.1 s). A: driving zurna riff over a 16th bağlama ostinato and syncopated 3+3+2 horn stabs, davul double time · B: the answer climbs to F#6 with male choir and horn swells, taiko on every downbeat; driving octave bass, darbuka 16ths, thunder on the downbeat, riser and fill back into A.
Ambience, 24 s seamless loop: steady rain (hiss, patter and droplets on stone), wandering wind with gusts and three distant thunder rolls at different distances; no tempo-bound material.

Free-spins intro, D Hicaz, 116 BPM: lightning crack and taiko on the downbeat, a horn call D–A–D–Eb–F#–A over a male-choir swell and a davul roll, the zurna's Eb→D appoggiatura and a D major chord with gong and cymbal on beat 4; the feature theme enters at beat 6 (3.10 s).

Retrigger (+5), D Hicaz, 116 BPM, 1 bar: lightning crack and taiko, a 32nd-note zurna flourish A–Bb–C–D–Eb–F# up to a held A5, horn stabs D–A–D on the "and" of 1 and on 2; ends at beat 3 (1.55 s) and rings over the feature theme.

Feature outro ("the storm subsides"), A Hicaz, 96 BPM: Gm – Bb – A with a ney phrase falling D–C#–Bb–A and rising to C#, bağlama strums, male choir and soft horn swell, a far rumble; base theme may return at beat 6 (3.75 s).

Total-win fanfare, A Hicaz-major, 120 BPM, 4 s: A – Dm – Gm | Bb – A. Festive zurna flourish with a dotted halay-like rhythm doubled by horns, bağlama strums, davul with stick roll, male choir on the final A with bronze bells, gong and thunder.

Big win tier 1 (Büyük), A Hicaz-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): thunder crack, zurna arpeggio climb with horn doubling an octave below, bağlama 16ths, horn chords, davul; the bII→I cadence lands on a held tonic with a bronze gong.

Big win tier 2 (Mega), B Hicaz-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): thunder crack, zurna arpeggio climb with horn doubling an octave below, bağlama 16ths, horn chords, davul, male choir; the bII→I cadence lands on a held tonic with a bronze gong.

Big win tier 3 (Süper), C# Hicaz-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): thunder crack, zurna arpeggio climb with horn doubling an octave below, bağlama 16ths, horn chords, davul, male choir, riser, double-time davul and low taiko; the bII→I cadence lands on a held tonic with a bronze gong.

Big win tier 4 (Efsane), E Hicaz-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): I – iv | bII – vii – I | I. Zurna lead with horn octave and horn chord stabs, full male choir, bağlama 16ths, bronze bells on every downbeat, taiko roll into the last bar, two thunder strikes, gong.

Max win, F# (top of the key ladder), 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): bVI – bVII – bII – I (D – E – G – F#) with zurna and horn octaves, a second horn line, full male choir, horn chords, bağlama 16ths, bronze bells, double-time davul, a taiko roll, three thunder strikes, gong and the longest rumble.
Count-up bed tier 1: I – bII – iv – bII/I in A Hicaz-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); bağlama 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and tek.
Count-up bed tier 2: I – bII – iv – bII/I in B Hicaz-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); bağlama 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and tek + davul groove, horn swells, darbuka ka.

Count-up bed tier 3: I – bII – iv – bII/I in C# Hicaz-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); bağlama 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and tek + davul groove, horn swells, darbuka ka + zurna lead and davul stick 8ths.

Count-up bed tier 4: I – bII – iv – bII/I in E Hicaz-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); bağlama 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and tek + davul groove, horn swells, darbuka ka + zurna lead and davul stick 8ths + male choir, bronze bells, taiko.

Count-up bed max win: I – bII – iv – bII/I in F# Hicaz-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); bağlama 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and tek + davul groove, horn swells, darbuka ka + zurna lead and davul stick 8ths + male choir, bronze bells, taiko + horn stabs, a second zurna an octave below, thunder rumbles.

escalation.note: Büyük → Mega → Süper → Efsane → max with count-up ticks; tier-up hits on the 120 BPM grid (planTierUp), landing at 22.3 s.

loadTiming.note: Core = base theme + core effects (rendered in parallel, ~4.6 s). The feature theme follows at ~9–10 s; the celebration group (callouts, tier-ups, landings, heads, beds) after it, everything by ~22 s. Until a lazy asset lands, the event falls back (callout → total-mult hit, landing → ding, others → live fallback voice).

summary.unitTests: 218/218 pass (apps/web), incl. tests/slot-audio-storm.test.ts and tests/slot-audio-storm-sound.test.ts; web typecheck clean

limitations: Nobody has listened to this set: the author cannot hear. Owner listening acceptance is required (WAV per asset below; storm-escalation-max.wav is the full climb).
Instruments are synthesized approximations, not recordings; zurna, ney and bağlama colour may read as "synth" on good speakers.
The character vocals are wordless synthetic placeholders; recorded lines plug into setVoiceBank("/audio/voice/storm") and were tested with fakes only (no files exist yet).

Runtime chain stress test (40 stacked effects + big-win head over the base theme) at unity sliders peaks at −0.97 dBTP (−1.08 at the default mix): the shared live master limiter is a DynamicsCompressor, not a true-peak limiter; Candy Cascade measured −1.24 in the same test. Every rendered asset is below −1 dBTP.
Very short UI/stone effects (click, tick, land) read 1.5–4 dB under their momentary class target because they are shorter than the 400 ms window and peak-limited (same as Candy Cascade).
Not verified: GitHub CI, a production (next build / Cloudflare) runtime, Safari/Firefox, mobile devices, and the game screen wiring (components/storm/** is another agent's).
